Q8095.reason: A five-month-old is in the indiscriminate attachment-in-the-making phase and will still accept an unfamiliar adult, unlike a pre-attachment 2-month-old or infants old enough for stranger anxiety.

Q5546.reason: A one-time shop fire from flammable residue is unreasonable care causing property damage; auto repair is not abnormally dangerous, the smoke entry was unintentional, and nuisance fits continuing invasions.
